name: wdbgmcp
description: MCP server that runs diagnostic commands on a Windows Debug Toolkit machine and returns their output to AI clients.

scripts.build:bundle: npm run build && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=bundle/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
